basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Bilaspur Registrar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bilaspur (AIIMS Bilaspur) has notified 1 vacancy for the post of Registrar on a deputation basis, with an initial period of deputation ordinarily lasting two years. The post carries Level 12 pay, governed by Central Government Employees rules including DoPT OM dated 28 February 2019, and requires a graduate degree with 7 years of administration experience. Eligible candidates should apply through the offline application process by sending the prescribed pro-forma through proper channel to the Deputy Director Administration, 3rd Floor, Administrative Blo

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for candidates should be 56 years as on the last date of receipt of application, i.e., 31 October 2026.

qualification.details: A graduate of a recognized University. Seven years' experience of administration in a supervisory capacity or as a teacher in a University/teaching institution including conduct of examination and admission and assignment of teaching program for undergraduate and postgraduate etc.

selection_process: Candidates will be selected through shortlisting of eligible applications. AIIMS Bilaspur reserves the right to conduct a written test or interview to shortlist or select candidates for the post.
how_to_apply: Download the application pro-forma from the official AIIMS Bilaspur recruitment website.
Fill out the application form completely in all respects and sign it.

Enclose self-attested copies of certificates regarding age, qualification, experience, caste certificate (if applicable), EWS/PwBD certificate, and No Objection Certificate from the parent department.
Enclose duly attested photocopies of up-to-date Confidential Reports for the latest 05 years by a competent authority.
Super-scribe the envelope containing the application as "Application for the post of Registrar on Deputation Basis for AIIMS, Bilaspur (H.P.)".
Submit the hard copy of the signed application through proper channel to reach the Deputy Director Administration on or before 31 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.
Deputy Director Administration,3rd Floor, Administrative Block (Recruitment Cell),All India Institute of Medical Sciences Kothipura, Bilaspur,Himachal Pradesh-174037
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date, unsigned, or incomplete will be summarily rejected. Online applications via email or any other mode will not be accepted. Candidates working in private organizations or institutes are strictly ineligible. No vigilance or disciplinary proceedings should be pending or contemplated against the candidate at the time of application. Advance copies of applications without vigilance clearance, ACRs/APARs dossiers, and forwarding through proper channel will only be considered provisionally if received by the due date. Canvassing in any form will lead to direct disqualification of candidature.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bilaspur Registrar at a Glance

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bilaspur (AIIMS Bilaspur)
Initial period of deputation ordinarily 2 years (extendable up to 1 year at a time)
Seven years' experience in administration in a supervisory capacity or as a teacher
Shortlisting followed by written test or interview

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must belong to Central/State/U.T. Governments/Universities/Statutory/Autonomous Bodies or Research and Development Organizations. Candidates working in private organizations or institutes are not eligible to apply. A graduate of a recognized University. Seven years' experience of administration in a supervisory capacity or as a teacher in a University/teaching institution including conduct of examination and admission and assignment of teaching program for undergraduate and postgraduate etc. The maximum age limit for candidates should be 56 years as on the last date of receipt of application, i.e., 31 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The selected officer will draw pay and allowances governed by rules applicable to Central Government Employees under Level 12 of the 7th CPC pay matrix, subject to DoPT OM no. 1/4/2017-Estt. (Pay-I) dated 28 February 2019 regarding regulation of pay under FR 35. The initial period of deputation is ordinarily two years, extendable up to one year at a time in accordance with DoPT guidelines. For officers from organizations with dissimilar pay and DA patterns, reverse foreign service terms apply without the option to draw parent cadre basic pay plus deputation allowance. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Bilaspur Registrar
content_sections.text: Download the application pro-forma from the official AIIMS Bilaspur recruitment website. Fill out the application form completely in all respects and sign it. Enclose self-attested copies of certificates regarding age, qualification, experience, caste certificate (if applicable), EWS/PwBD certificate, and No Objection Certificate from the parent department. Enclose duly attested photocopies of up-to-date Confidential Reports for the latest 05 years by a competent authority. Super-scribe the envelope containing the application as "Application for the post of Registrar on Deputation Basis for AIIMS, Bilaspur (H.P.)". Submit the hard copy of the signed application through proper channel to reach the Deputy Director Administration on or before 31 October 2026 by 5:00 PM. Postal Address for Submission: Deputy Director Administration,3rd Floor, Administrative Block (Recruitment Cell),All India Institute of Medical Sciences Kothipura, Bilaspur,Himachal Pradesh-174037

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected through shortlisting of eligible applications. AIIMS Bilaspur reserves the right to conduct a written test or interview to shortlist or select candidates for the post.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date, unsigned, or incomplete will be summarily rejected. Online applications via email or any other mode will not be accepted. Candidates working in private organizations or institutes are strictly ineligible. No vigilance or disciplinary proceedings should be pending or contemplated against the candidate at the time of application. Advance copies of applications without vigilance clearance, ACRs/APARs dossiers, and forwarding through proper channel will only be considered provisionally if received by the due date. Canvassing in any form will lead to direct disqualification of candidature.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post notified in the AIIMS Bilaspur recruitment?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bilaspur has notified 1 vacancy for the post of Registrar on a deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the hard copy of the application through proper channel is 31 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the pay scale for the AIIMS Bilaspur Registrar post?
faq.answer: The Registrar post carries Level 12 pay as per the 7th CPC pay matrix.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 56 years as on the last date of receipt of application, which is 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a graduate degree from a recognized University along with seven years of administrative experience in a supervisory capacity or as a teacher in a University or teaching institution.

faq.question: Q6. Can candidates from private organizations apply for this deputation post?
faq.answer: No, the posts advertised are not applicable for candidates working in private organizations or institutes.

faq.question: Q7. How should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in hard copy format through proper channel via post or courier to the Deputy Director Administration at AIIMS Bilaspur.

faq.question: Q8. What is the initial duration of the deputation period?
faq.answer: The initial period of deputation is ordinarily two years, which may be extendable up to one year at a time.

faq.question: Q9. Will a written test or interview be conducted for selection?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bilaspur reserves the right to conduct a written test or interview to shortlist or select candidates for the post.
